text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis and preview in the opening paragraph","quality":"organization","description":"It presents a clear position early and organizes the reasons that will support it."},{"evidence":"three developed body paragraphs with separate reasons","quality":"reasoning development","description":"It expands multiple claims with explanation rather than relying on brief assertions."},{"evidence":"repeated use of article quotations and paraphrases","quality":"textual support","description":"It anchors its argument in details from the source article more consistently."},{"evidence":"counterargument paragraph on boredom and distraction","quality":"addressing opposing views","description":"It acknowledges a likely objection and responds to it with a rebuttal."},{"evidence":"concluding restatement with future outlook","quality":"conclusion","description":"It closes by restating the main claim and ending with a broader forward-looking point."}]}
